{{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PS150 |prevtitle=Chinchou in Charge |nextcode=PS152 |nexttitle=Buzz Off, Butterfree! |series=Gold, Silver & Crystal |colorscheme=Johto}} {{ChapInfobox |title_en=Lovely Lanturn |title_ja=VS ランターン |title_ro=VS Lantern |image=PS151.png |scheme=Gold, Silver & Crystal |pub1=Shogakukan full volume |pub1-data=Chapter 151 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|12}} |pub2=VIZ Media full volume |pub2-data=Adventure 151 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|12}} |location=[[Tohjo Falls]] }} '''Lovely Lanturn''' (Japanese: '''VS ランターン''' ''VS {{tt|Lantern|Lanturn}}''), titled '''Upstream-Swimmer Lanturn''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 151st chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 61st chapter of the {{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} In the rock shelter behind the [[Tohjo Falls]], [[Misty]] gasps as {{DL|Legendary beasts (Adventures)|Suicune}} appears before her. Suicune immediately begins to attack, knocking {{TP|Misty|Starmie}} away with a {{m|Headbutt}}. Misty responds by calling out her {{p|Lanturn}} to use {{m|Hydro Pump}}. Suicune counters with its own Hydro Pump, blasting Misty and Lanturn into the waterfall. Suicune looks over the waterfall to see that Lanturn is keeping Misty afloat. Misty, with her proud declaration as an expert of the {{type|Water}}, accepts Suicune's challenge. On the [[Johto]] side of the falls, [[Brock]] and [[Erika]] are on the former's {{p|Onix}} looking for Misty. Erika receives a message on her [[Pokégear]] and finds out that a series of {{wp|exhibition game|exhibition match}}es have been agreed between the Kanto and Johto [[Gym Leader]]s as part of the introduction to the upcoming [[Indigo Plateau|Pokémon League]] tournament. Brock and Erika then see water being blasted out through the waterfall and realize that Misty is having a battle. They then see Misty and her opponent appearing to fall into the waterfall again, with the latter shooting another round of water that hits Onix. Misty, who finds herself under the water at the base of the Tohjo Falls, suddenly clutches her head. Through Starmie, she finds out what Suicune is communicating to her, and is surprised to learn that Suicune has deemed her worthy of something. Suicune adds the reason for choosing Misty - she is not only a Water-type expert but also has compassion for life. Misty decides to accept Suicune's companionship. Misty finally emerges above the water to get on Onix with Brock and Erika. Misty sheepishly gives nothing away when asked by Brock about what she battled. Erika then shows her the message the [[Pokémon Association]] sent to the Gym Leaders, and Misty becomes excited at the prospect of facing one of her Johto counterparts. Erika states that she will captain the [[Kanto]] Gym Leaders and [[Pryce]] will be in charge of the Johto Gym Leaders. As the trio resume their journey to [[Goldenrod City]], Suicune is in one of Misty's [[Great Ball]]s, at peace for the first time in a while. ==Major events== * [[Misty]] catches {{DL|Legendary beasts (Adventures)|Suicune}}. * [[Misty]], [[Brock]], and [[Erika]] find out that they have to fight the [[Johto]] [[Gym Leader]]s in the upcoming [[Pokémon League]]. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Lanturn}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * [[Brock]] * [[Misty]] * [[Erika]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Onix}} ({{OP|Brock|Onix}}) * {{p|Starmie}} ({{OP|Misty|Starmie}}) * {{p|Chinchou}} ([[Misty]]'s) * {{p|Lanturn}} ([[Misty]]'s) * {{p|Suicune}} ({{DL|Legendary beasts (Adventures)|Suicune|Misty's}}; new) * {{p|Krabby}} ==Trivia== * Similar to a [[PS085|previous chapter]], the "ancient star glyphs" written out by Starmie are actually {{wp|medieval runes}}. ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{colorschemelight|Johto}}|bordercolor={{colorschemedark|Johto}} |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 電燈怪|VS Lanturn}} (Taiwan)
